title: Sonshine by the Sea | 4BR Rental on 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Sonshine by the Sea is a luxury 4BR Seagrove home with a private pool and trail access. Enjoy 4 adult bikes and a 4-block walk to the beach. Reserve today!
description_expanded: Description: Sonshine by the Sea by Royal Destinations Location: Seagrove Beach Address: 496 San Juan Avenue, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Welcome to Sonshine by the Sea! This newly constructed 30A vacation rental is a paradise for outdoor enthusiasts. Whether you prefer splashing in the refreshing Gulf waters, relaxing by your private pool, or exploring Santa Rosa Beach’s picturesque trails, there’s something for everyone. The Longleaf Greenway Trail, which offers 11 miles of scenic beauty, starts right next to the home, making it easy to explore on foot or with one of the four complimentary adult bikes provided. After a morning hike or bike ride, unwind with a swim in the pool—it’s the perfect way to spend the day. Those looking for 30A vacation rentals with private pools are sure to be impressed. Just four blocks (0.4 miles) away, you’ll find the stunning beaches of the Emerald Coast. Both the San Juan Beach Access and the Santa Clara Regional Beach Access are just a short and easy walk or bike ride from the home. Inside, this Seagrove Beach vacation rental features two living rooms and a spacious, open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area, ideal for families to relax and create lasting memories together. Don’t forget to jot down your favorite vacation moments in Sonshine by the Sea’s guestbook! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 0.4 Miles Away Or Four Blocks (Parking at Bramble Beach Available) -Short distance from the Santa Clara Beach Access. This beach access is wheelchair accessible and has restrooms, parking, and lifeguards. -Trailhead for biking and hiking opens right beside the home. 11 miles of exploration await! -Private Heated Pool* -Parking Spaces: 3 -Dining Accommodations: Table and Bar Seating -Coffee Maker/Keurig Available -Poolside Seating Area -Propane Grill *Pool Heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax). *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 3.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub/Separate Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Open Floor Plan Living Room -Pool Lanai, Patio and Outdoor Dining -Half Bath -Laundry Room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 4: Bunk Room with 2 Bunk Sets (XL Twin/XL Twin) -Sleeper Sofa (Full) -Family Room Amenities Include: -4 Adult Bikes -Biking and Hiking Trails Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
